title: Robustness of Starobinsky inflation in a minimal two-field scalar-tensor completion
summary: We investigate whether the Starobinsky inflation remains robust after including a minimal scalar extension motivated by the one-loop effective action of scalar-tensor gravity. We numerically solve the four-dimensional background system derived from the reduced slow-roll action and discover that the exact Starobinsky branch is a finite-time attractor in the sampled slow-roll domain when the additional scalar is at least as heavy as the scalaron.
